page_title: Nimbalyst: Agent Wiki and Workspace for Claude Code and Codex

sources.entry: Nimbalyst - A visual workspace for managing AI coding sessions, tasks, and project files.

summary.name: Nimbalyst
summary.one_liner: Nimbalyst is a free, local, open source visual workspace and wiki for managing sessions, tasks, docs and code alongside AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex.
use_cases: organize decisions and open questions from coding agent work
manage Claude Code or Codex sessions visually
keep an editable wiki written by coding agents
share an agent-maintained wiki with a team
track tasks, docs and diagrams next to code
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two parts. Nimbalyst Wiki is a free plugin for Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, Cursor, VS Code or any MCP agent, where agents organize decisions, questions and project context into a wiki the user can edit; it requires no app or account. Nimbalyst App is a visual workspace for agents, tasks, docs, wiki, diagrams and code, free for individuals and used with an existing Claude Code or Codex subscription or API key. Wiki Teams is a paid plan that lets teammates' agents contribute to a shared wiki, with browser-based real-time editing and visibility into open questions and who made each decision; it is free during Beta.
notable: Wiki that coding agents write and maintain as a plugin, no app or account needed
Visual workspace combining agents, tasks, docs, wiki, diagrams and code
Works with existing Claude Code or Codex subscription or API key
Wiki Teams shares a wiki across teammates' agents with real-time browser editing
caveats: Wiki Teams is a paid plan (free during Beta)
Individual App use is free but relies on the user's own Claude Code or Codex subscription or API key
